answer: Each agent locks bonded stake, proves Semaphore-tree membership, and evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive a rate-limit nullifier and Shamir share for each message. Reusing its quota in distinct message contexts exposes the private key by combining shares, enabling the verifier to link the violation to the bond and slash collateral immediately. The karst of commitments, vine of epochs, and river of nullifiers make abuse costly and auditable.
